semiconductor_relevance: High — Sonix Korea specializes in non-destructive testing equipment and scanning acoustic microscopes crucial for semiconductor reliability and quality assurance.
summary: Sonix Korea is a leading manufacturer of scanning acoustic microscopes and non-destructive testing equipment used in the semiconductor industry. Their technology enables high-resolution imaging and advanced diagnostics to detect defects in bonded wafers and packaged semiconductors, supporting manufacturers in improving process control and product reliability.
capabilities: Scanning Acoustic Microscopes (SAM) for delamination and void detection
Non-destructive testing equipment for semiconductor inspection
Advanced diagnostic tools for reliability verification
Process control solutions for semiconductor manufacturing
